lines: Thank you for your interest in doing business with SCCHA.

We are excited to announce that the Santa Clara County Housing Authority has transitioned to a NEW and improved E-Procurement platform, PlanetBids. This platform will streamline the way we manage vendor registrations, bidding opportunities, and contract management.
• Register Now: All vendors, new and existing, must register on PlanetBids to continue bidding on opportunities with SCCHA. Click “Register Here” to create your vendor profile.
• Bid Opportunities: New bidding opportunities are available exclusively through PlanetBids. Vendors can search, download documents, and submit bids online.
• Stay Informed: Once registered, you’ll receive automatic notifications of relevant bid opportunities and have the ability to bid.
• No Cost to Register: Vendor registration is free.

If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to Procurement@scchousingauthority.org. We appreciate your cooperation during this transition and look forward to continued collaboration through PlanetBids.
Receive Regular Notifications of New, Modified and Awarded Solicitations
To contact the Procurement Department, please contact procurement@scchousingauthority.org.
SCCHA pays all contractors a living wage.
